item.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
item.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

item.title: King Charles III clarifies status of Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan
item.description: King Charles III has reiterated that Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, remain non-working members of the royal family following their return to the United Kingdom.

item.title: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
item.description: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assistance.

item.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
item.description: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

item.title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
item.description: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.

item.title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
item.description: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

item.title: Scene at Miami airport where five died described as 'utter devastation'
item.description: An Amazon Prime cargo plane overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles, where it then caught on fire. All those who died were passengers on the ground.
